digest.component_or_area: Config sources and resolvers module refactoring
propositions: src/rebar/_config_sources.py exceeds the near-cap warning band at 791 LOC (>= 720 threshold) and will break CI on the next config change due to the 800-LOC hard cap.
The module naturally partitions into two concerns: raw-input resolution (lines 31-361) and RP-04 below-seam owned resolvers (lines 364-791), already delineated by in-file banner comments.

Moving 29 resolver-related symbols to a new _config_resolvers.py module requires _snapshot_table to resolve three back-references (_user_config_path, _read_toml_table, _discover_project_config) through lazy in-body module import to preserve late binding and support monkeypatching.

The split must maintain byte-identical import surface: re-exporting all 29 moved names from _config_sources.py preserves rebar._config_sources.<name> and rebar.config.<name> resolution, and docs/env-vars.md requires regeneration due to moved env-name string literals and citation relocation.

Config ownership seam integrity requires _config_resolvers.py to be added to COMPOSITION_ROOT_BASENAMES in check_config_ownership.py, and the split introduces new seam tests validating acyclicity, binding, and composition-root recognition.
